dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetrical 2D geometric narrowing of the body mass from the mid-section toward both the cranial and posterior extremities.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-to-medium grey baseline with a median pixel intensity shifted toward a cool blue-grey spectrum.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse clusters of darker grey pixels distributed across the cranial and lateral dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the primary light grey canvas and darker mottled regions.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Multiple fine, linear high-contrast marks and superficial scratches visible on the central and posterior dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Superficial linear scarring patterns distributed across the visible dorsal surface.
